simple.meaning: a weaving ; a braid ; also a shuttle
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֶרֶג (H708) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֶרֶג (ʼereg) means a weaving ; a braid ; also a shuttle First listed occurrence: Job 7 6.

definitions.short: a weaving ; a braid ; also a shuttle
definitions.full: H708. ereg אֶ֫רֶג noun [masculine] loom (see GFM POS Oct.1889 ) — אֶרֶג Judg 16:4 hand-loom to which Samson's hair was fastened, plucked up by him ( ׳א object of וַיִּסַּע ; strike out הַיְתַד as gloss, compare GFM above); Job 7:6 אָ֑רֶג מִנִּי קַלּוּ יָמַי my days are swifter than a loom. אַרְגֹּב see רגב . אַרְגָּז see רגז .
